name: mac-health-monitor
description: Reads the health of Boss's Mac — free disk, battery, memory pressure, what is eating space, whether the agent's own daemon is alive — and reports it in plain Bangla. Use when Boss asks whether his Mac is healthy, why it is slow or full, or what is running on it.
whenNotToUse: Actually clearing space by moving or trashing files → mac-file-organizer. A picture of the screen → screenshot-annotate-share. Anything about the VPS or the website — this is his laptop only.
stopConditions: কোনো সংখ্যা টুল থেকে পাওয়া যায়নি — আন্দাজে বলা নয়
কিছু ঠিক করতে হবে — এই skill শুধু দেখে, বদলায় না
